headline.en: An AI that remembers your whole life — cents per turn, not dollars.
headline.zh: 一个记得你一生的 AI —— 每轮几分钱，而不是几美元。

sub.en: Memoir assembles your notes into a cache-stable personal-history prefix and re-sends it to DeepSeek every turn. The prefix-cache discount makes whole-life recall affordable — no summarization, no RAG, your full history on every turn.
sub.zh: Memoir 把你的笔记拼装成缓存稳定的个人历史前缀，每轮重新发给 DeepSeek。前缀缓存折扣让“全量记忆”负担得起——不做摘要、不用 RAG，每轮都发完整历史。

body.en: Not RAG and not summarization. Memoir re-sends your complete personal history on every turn, so cross-note patterns survive. ChatGPT Memory retrieves fragments; you get the whole record, verbatim.
body.zh: 不是 RAG，也不是摘要。Memoir 每轮都把你的完整个人历史重新发出，跨笔记的综合判断不会丢。ChatGPT Memory 只检索片段；你拿到的是整份记录，原文照发。

body.en: Sources are sorted by path then content hash, so the assembled prefix is byte-identical across sessions and machines. cache_stable=True verifies re-assembly reproduces the same bytes — the property that triggers DeepSeek's prefix-cache discount.
body.zh: 按路径与内容哈希排序，拼出的前缀跨会话、跨机器逐字节一致。cache_stable=True 校验重新拼装得到相同字节——这正是触发 DeepSeek 前缀缓存折扣的性质。

title.zh: 比 gpt-4o 便宜约 11 倍

body.en: On the demo prefix (346 tokens, ~300 output), DeepSeek steady-state costs ~$0.0004/turn vs ~$0.0039/turn on gpt-4o without caching — about 11x cheaper. A 20k-token lifelong prefix runs roughly $0.35/month at 200 turns.
body.zh: 在演示前缀（346 token、约 300 输出）上，DeepSeek 稳态约 $0.0004/轮，而 gpt-4o 不开缓存约 $0.0039/轮——便宜约 11 倍。2 万 token 的一生体量前缀，每月 200 轮约 $0.35/月。

body.en: The prefix is assembled on your machine and sent to DeepSeek with your own API key. Notes leave your device for inference only, not for storage. State lives under ~/.memoir/.
body.zh: 前缀在你本机拼装，用你自己的 API key 发给 DeepSeek。笔记只为推理发出，不存储。状态文件位于 ~/.memoir/。

note.en: Real CLI output from examples/notes (4 small notes). ingest and cost run fully offline; chat needs a DeepSeek API key. Reproduce with the Quickstart below.
note.zh: examples/notes（4 篇小笔记）的真实 CLI 输出。ingest 与 cost 完全离线运行；chat 需要 DeepSeek API key。按下方快速开始复现。

body.en: Point Memoir at any folder of .md/.txt notes. It assembles a cache-stable prefix and writes the manifest.
body.zh: 把 Memoir 指向任意 .md/.txt 笔记文件夹，它会拼装缓存稳定的前缀并写出 manifest。

body.en: Chat with an AI that has read everything you've written. Each turn prints the real DeepSeek prefix-cache cost vs the OpenAI equivalent.
body.zh: 与一个读过你全部笔记的 AI 对话。每轮打印真实的 DeepSeek 前缀缓存费用与 OpenAI 等价成本。

body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. ingest and cost run fully offline; chat needs a DeepSeek API key from platform.deepseek.com. State lives under ~/.memoir/.
body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。ingest 与 cost 完全离线运行；chat 需要从 platform.deepseek.com 获取 DeepSeek API key。状态文件位于 ~/.memoir/。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/memoir.git
cd memoir
uv pip install -e .   # or: pip install -e .

limitations.en: CLI only for v0.1 — no web or desktop GUI yet.
limitations.zh: v0.1 仅 CLI——尚无网页或桌面 GUI。

limitations.en: DeepSeek only — no multi-model support yet.
limitations.zh: 仅支持 DeepSeek——尚无多模型支持。

limitations.en: Local folder only — no Notion or Apple Notes API auto-sync.
limitations.zh: 仅本地文件夹——不做 Notion 或 Apple Notes API 自动同步。

limitations.en: No encryption at rest — notes leave your machine for inference only, not for storage. Encryption is planned for v0.2.
limitations.zh: 无落盘加密——笔记只为推理发出，不存储。落盘加密计划在 v0.2。

limitations.en: chat needs a live DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; ingest, cost, and status run fully offline.
limitations.zh: chat 需要真实的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY；ingest、cost、status 完全离线运行。
